title: Palacio Errázuriz Alvear, Buenos Aires

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain near the outer circular portico. Exact entrance thresholds and garden levels remain approximate.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap way 619353732 fixes the palace outline and the circular entrance portico. Argentina’s national monuments record identifies the 1902 Avenida del Libertador site and its circular portico, Corinthian avenue front and pilastered garden elevations.

identities.name: National Museum of Decorative Arts, Buenos Aires

names: National Museum of Decorative Arts, Buenos Aires
mapIdentity.scope: Original palace body, attached garden terrace and circular entrance portico controlled by mapped way 619353732. Four cleared photographs establish garden windows and giant order, open columned portico, and avenue pediment.

note: Terraced building on the original terrain. The portico approach is the source-ground datum. The portico platform and garden principal threshold are estimated 0.32 m above that reference, with the basement and attached terrace extending down the hillside.
